title: Eventual polynomial size characterization
statement: A Boolean language $L$ has polynomial-size Boolean circuit families with fan-in at most two if and only if there are a natural number $c$ and a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two that recognizes exactly $L$ and has size at most $n^c$ for every input length $n\ge 2$.
